484fe3d1-d2e6-5771-b474-3a12957263d7.content: Begin waterproofing and piping work only after personal belongings have been removed from the underground parking garage and the storage zones have been marked.

8c94fce2-7299-521f-b98e-94889d89a460.content: Conduct the emergency power transfer test after the main distribution panel replacement is complete and before the fire protection interoperation test.

c6e4612a-0733-534e-a9e0-80eb3f891307.content: Do not take both elevators out of service at the same time; begin work on the other elevator only after completing the test run of one elevator.

fd286ca4-7710-553a-92c7-8a6683b41d23.content: Do not completely demolish the main entrance and accessible route on the same day; divide the work into two sections so that a temporary passage remains available.

ffd2fe80-2a3d-5aa5-b8c5-9f1382ec525c.content: Isolate heating and cooling piping only during short inspection windows that permit measurement verification, and move to the next section after normal pressure has returned.

25857a9d-d9cb-55b3-8db3-801c27bdd9bf.content: Begin integrated building commissioning only after all individual electrical, fire protection, elevator, and heating and cooling test records have been submitted.

065cb7e2-1860-536d-bb8a-2af1ef8d70e2.content: The site schedule manager judges that approving subsequent work without a completion record for prerequisite work poses a greater risk than failing to meet the schedule.
